model: R11.80 measured: x1.0 -> h=69.0, x3.0 -> h=142.4 (2.06x). Extending the boost window 18 -> 30 frames did not change height, so a constant gravity component caps it. Height factor = 1/((1-w) + w/d) with w = 0.772 (share of ascent gravity coming from get_CustomGravity; the rest is the unhookable inline -9.8 in JLPJMAFLADI). R11.81 inverts the model: d = w/(1/target - (1-w)), clamped 1..20, so the slider maps to the requested height multiplier. Validated against the Bay measurement: bay 2.05 predicted 1.65x, measured 1.6x.
